description: As a Service Planner, I need urgent service requests to route to a Service Manager so that dispatch only proceeds after eligibility and entitlement are confirmed.

acceptanceRequirements.given: an urgent service request has entitlement and safety details
acceptanceRequirements.when: the Service Planner submits the request for approval
acceptanceRequirements.then: the Service Manager can approve or reject the request with a recorded decision

acceptanceRequirements.given: an urgent service request is missing entitlement evidence
acceptanceRequirements.when: the Service Planner attempts to submit it for dispatch
acceptanceRequirements.then: the workflow pauses and prompts the planner to collect the missing authorization

description: As a Dispatch Manager, I need approved loaner requests to reserve available equipment so that customers receive temporary equipment without double-booking inventory.

acceptanceRequirements.given: a loaner request has been approved
acceptanceRequirements.when: available equipment is selected for the customer
acceptanceRequirements.then: the equipment is reserved and cannot be assigned to another request

acceptanceRequirements.given: a returned loaner has not yet been inspected
acceptanceRequirements.when: a planner searches for available equipment
acceptanceRequirements.then: the returned loaner is excluded until inspection marks it available
